title: MRFAD - Reimu fumo
description: (UNFINISHED) A mod that adds reimu fumo to the game.
body:
(This project is unfinished, so I recommend you guys to download another mod or editing the source code to make the mod runs properly.)
A mod that adds fumo to the game.
Source code here: https://github.com/lequangminhchxhcn-arch/Modrideforarchdecoration-Reimu_fumo-source-code
SUPPORT & HELP 

1: How to make reimu fumo portal:

    1: Build a portal (nether portal) but with Block of reimu fumo instead of obsidian

     2: Use Super gohei to ignite the portal (just like flint and steel), then enter the portal.

2: How to gain reimu fumo ingots:

     1: You'll need to find a reimu fumo ore (A block with a bootleg reimu fumo) in caves, mine it and

     you have the Raw reimu fumo

     2: Smelt Raw reimu fumo in a furnace to get reimu fumo ingots (5xp per smelt)

3: How do I have all that stuff in survival?

     I recommend you to trade with a toolsmith villager, he's having all of them if you accept the gambling       experience LOL :)))

     You can still craft all that stuff if you unlocked the recipe by obtaining the needing materials.

Mods content:

   ver 0.5.5 alpha: Adds:

      Reimu fumo ingots

      Block of Reimu fumo

      Liquid reimu fumo (bucket)

      Gohei

      Super gohei

      Raw reimu fumo

      Reimu fumo ore

      Reimu 3 D (model error)

Updates are coming soon!
Made with MCreator.
